scenarios.name: constant_speed_first_sample_artifact
scenarios.description: Constant speed and satisfied PV remain clear. The speed-mean crossing branch has a zero-area initialization pulse and one harmless fill artifact, neither of which can satisfy both speed criteria.

scenarios.name: load_step_monotonic_recovery
scenarios.description: After a settled baseline, speed moves once from 50% to 60% while PV carries a 20-unit error for only five minutes. The error area is below pv_allowance_band times the window and the speed never repeatedly crosses its center.

scenarios.name: fast_shallow_dither
scenarios.description: A four-minute speed cycle crosses often but stays at +/-4%; its settled speed MAD is below the strict 5-point materiality threshold. PV is satisfied.

scenarios.name: speed_mad_just_below_threshold
scenarios.description: A +/-4.9% square speed wave brackets the computed materiality boundary from the nonfaulting side. Rolling MAD is not asserted at an exact equality edge; the process branch is independently active.

scenarios.name: speed_mad_just_above_threshold
scenarios.description: A +/-5.1% square wave brackets the materiality boundary from the active side. Fast crossings and unstable process error allow the combined fault to mature.

scenarios.name: speed_hunting_process_stable
scenarios.description: Material fast speed motion is present, but PV stays on setpoint; the speed diagnostic can guide tuning without producing the combined fault.

scenarios.name: slow_deep_speed_motion
scenarios.description: A deep ten-minute speed cycle has large MAD but only three mean crossings per 900-second window, below the strict count limit. PV remains unsatisfied, isolating the speed-frequency rejection.

scenarios.name: process_unstable_speed_stable
scenarios.description: PV alternates 12 units around setpoint while speed is fixed. The process diagnostic is active after warm-up, but the rule refuses to call it VFD hunting without material speed crossings.

scenarios.name: count_exactly_allowed
scenarios.description: A 900-second repeating speed pattern produces six mean crossings per full window with material MAD. The strict count > 6 comparison keeps ySpeedHunting and the combined fault clear while the process branch is active.

scenarios.name: one_crossing_over_limit
scenarios.description: A repeating seven-crossing pattern is one event above the allowed six, with material speed MAD and unstable process error; all raw criteria and the delayed fault remain active after warm-up.

scenarios.name: pv_mae_exactly_threshold
scenarios.description: With established speed hunting, a constant absolute PV error of exactly 10.0 loop units leaves the strict process-MAE comparison false and blocks the fault.

scenarios.name: pv_mae_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: A 10.1-unit mean absolute PV error brackets the process boundary from the active side while the speed branch is materially hunting.

scenarios.name: persistent_both_error_directions
scenarios.description: Material speed hunting paired with PV alternating above and below setpoint proves the process statistic is symmetric and the combined fault persists.

scenarios.name: one_sided_oscillatory_process_offset
scenarios.description: PV oscillates between 20 and 30 units above setpoint while speed hunts. Crossings around the rolling process-error mean plus MAE from the real setpoint intentionally classify this one-sided oscillatory offset as unstable; this is broader than NIST's two-sided allowance-band CUSUM.

scenarios.name: window_aging_clears
scenarios.description: The loop hunts through t=3600 s and then speed settles while PV remains 11 units off setpoint. The process diagnostic stays active; speed crossings and MAD must age out before the fault clears.

scenarios.name: warmup_burst_raw_behavior
scenarios.description: Eight tick-rate speed changes during the partial-window fill can be extrapolated above the rolling count threshold while PV is off setpoint. The raw result is pinned; hosts must report NO_EVAL during the first evaluation window.

scenarios.name: setpoint_step_excluded_raw_behavior
scenarios.description: A setpoint step at t=1800 followed by sustained materially reversing speed raises the raw diagnostics and fault. Deployment must instead report NO_EVAL until reset and disturbance response are settled.

scenarios.name: subtick_hunting_aliases_clear
scenarios.description: A host sampling once per minute cannot see an even number of reversals that occur and return between samples; the staged trace is therefore constant and every output stays clear. This pins the Nyquist limitation, not healthy plant behavior.
